svg.title: Alley cropping: crops grown between rows of leguminous trees
svg.desc: A plan view of a field. Rows of leguminous trees such as Gliricidia or Leucaena run along the contour, about 4 to 6 metres apart. Food crops such as maize and cassava grow in the alleys between them. The trees are pruned regularly; the prunings are spread as mulch and green manure, adding nitrogen and organic matter.
svg.text: Prunings are spread in the alleys as mulch and green manure.
